en: An area of water for swimming; or a small amount of liquid on a surface; or to join money or resources with others.
ex: The children are swimming in the pool.
孩子們在游泳池裡游泳。

en: Having very little money; or of low quality; or deserving sympathy.
ex: The poor man had no food or money.
那個窮人沒有食物，也沒有錢。

en: A snack made from corn that is heated until it bursts open; often eaten at the cinema.
ex: We ate popcorn while watching the movie.
我們邊看電影邊吃爆米花。

en: Liked or enjoyed by many people; or relating to ordinary people.
ex: Pizza is popular with children.
披薩深受孩子們歡迎。

en: Able to happen or be done; or that can be.
ex: Is it possible to finish the work by Friday?
能在星期五前完成這項工作嗎？

en: A round container used for cooking or for plants; or a large amount of money in a game.
ex: She put the soup in a big pot.
她把湯放進一個大鍋裡。

en: A round vegetable with a brown skin that grows under the ground and is cooked in many ways.
ex: We had fish and potatoes for dinner.
我們晚餐吃魚和馬鈴薯。

en: The ability to do something or influence people; or a force used to make something work, such as electricity.
ex: The power went out during the storm.
暴風雨期間停電了。

en: To do something again and again to get better at it; or the activity of doing so; or a usual way of doing something.
ex: I practice the piano for an hour every day.
我每天練習一小時鋼琴。

en: To make something or someone ready for something; or to get ready for something to happen.
ex: She is preparing dinner in the kitchen.
她正在廚房準備晚餐。

en: A thing you give to someone; or the time now; or being in a place; or to give something to someone formally.
ex: She gave me a lovely present for my birthday.
她給了我一份很棒的生日禮物。

en: Attractive in a delicate way; or fairly or quite.
ex: She wore a pretty dress to the party.
她穿著一件漂亮的洋裝去參加派對。

en: The amount of money you must pay to buy something; or to decide how much something costs.
ex: What is the price of this jacket?
這件夾克的價格是多少？

en: Used when you think something is likely to be true or likely to happen.
ex: It will probably rain tomorrow.
明天大概會下雨。

en: Something that is difficult and causes trouble; or a question that you must solve.
ex: We need to solve this problem quickly.
我們需要快點解決這個問題。

en: A TV or radio show; or a set of instructions that tells a computer what to do; or a plan of events.
ex: My favorite TV program starts at eight.
我最喜歡的電視節目八點開始。

en: Feeling pleased about something you or someone you know has done; or thinking you are better than others.
ex: The mother is proud of her son's success.
那位母親為兒子的成功感到驕傲。

en: Relating to or for people in general; or the people of a community or country.
ex: The city has a large public library.
這座城市有一間大型公共圖書館。

en: To use force to move something toward you; or to attract people or things; or to remove something.
ex: Pull the door to open it.
拉開這扇門。

en: To use force to move someone or something away from you; or to press something; or to encourage someone to do something.
ex: Please push the door to open it.
請推開這扇門。

en: To move something to a particular place or position; or to express something in words.
ex: Please put your bag on the chair.
請把你的包包放在椅子上。

en: One of four equal parts of something; or fifteen minutes; or a part of a town.
ex: It is a quarter to six, and we are late.
現在是五點四十五分，我們遲到了。

en: A woman who rules a country; or the wife of a king; or an important piece in chess.
ex: The queen waved to the crowd.
女王向人群揮手。

en: A sentence that asks for information; or to ask someone questions; or to doubt something.
ex: Can I ask you a question about the homework?
我可以問你一個關於作業的問題嗎？

en: Done or happening in a short time; or moving fast; or able to learn fast.
ex: Take a quick look at this letter.
快速看一下這封信。

en: Making very little noise; or calm and peaceful.
ex: Please be quiet in the library.
請在圖書館保持安靜。

en: To a fairly large degree; or completely.
ex: The film was quite good, but a bit too long.
這部電影相當好看，但有點太長。

en: A small furry animal with long ears that lives in a hole in the ground.
ph: pull a rabbit out of a hat
變魔術般地變出解決辦法
ex: The rabbit ate a carrot in the garden.
兔子在花園裡吃了一根胡蘿蔔。

en: A competition in which people try to be the fastest; or a group of people with the same origin; or to move quickly.
ex: He won the 100-meter race at school.
他在學校贏得了一百公尺賽跑。

en: A machine that receives sound signals so you can listen to music or news; or the system of broadcasting sound.
ex: I listen to the radio while I cook.
我煮飯時聽廣播。

en: Water that falls from the sky in drops; or to fall as water from clouds.
ex: It started to rain, so we went inside.
開始下雨了，所以我們進到裡面。

en: An arch of seven colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.
ex: We saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
雨後我們看到一道美麗的彩虹。

en: With a lot of rain; or having rain.
ex: It is a rainy day, so we are staying at home.
今天下雨，所以我們待在家裡。

en: To lift something to a higher position; or to increase an amount; or to bring up a child.
ex: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
如果你知道答案，請舉手。

en: To arrive at a place; or to stretch out your hand to touch something; or to contact someone.
ex: We will reach the station in ten minutes.
我們十分鐘後會到車站。

en: To look at words and understand their meaning; or to say words aloud from a book.
ex: She reads a book every night before bed.
她每晚睡前讀一本書。

en: Prepared for something; or willing to do something; or available for use.
ex: Are you ready to go to school?
你準備好去上學了嗎？

en: Actually existing and not imagined; or genuine and not false.
ex: This is a real gold ring, not a fake one.
這是真的金戒指，不是假的。

en: In fact or truth; or very much; or used to show surprise.
ex: I really enjoyed the movie last night.
我真的很喜歡昨晚的電影。

en: The cause or explanation for something; or the ability to think in a logical way.
ex: Do you know the reason for his absence?
你知道他缺席的原因嗎？
